title: Ship Launch Diagnostic System
description: Build the complete ship diagnostic system. Integrate ALL fundamentals: variables, control flow, libraries, custom keywords, templates, error handling. If all tests pass, the ship launches.

instructions: This challenge is OPEN-ENDED. Build a complete diagnostic suite with the following requirements:
- Suite Documentation describing the diagnostic system
- Suite Setup: Log test start time
- Suite Teardown: Log test end time and duration
- Create 'Check System Power' keyword with arguments
- Test 1: 'Power Systems Check' (use FOR loop + custom keyword)
- Test 3: 'Communication Test' (use TRY/EXCEPT for error handling)
- Assertions: At least 10 different assertion checks (Chapter 1)
- Custom Keywords: With arguments and return values (Chapter 2)
- FOR loop: Iterate through systems list (Chapter 3)
- IF/ELSE: Conditional logic based on system state (Chapter 3)
- WHILE loop: Monitor until condition met (Chapter 3)
- TRY/EXCEPT: Handle at least one error gracefully (Chapter 3)
- Collections library: Use Append To List, Get From Dictionary (Chapter 4)
- String library: Use Split String or Replace String (Chapter 4)
- DateTime library: Timestamp start/end, calculate duration (Chapter 4)
- At least 47 total system checks (across all tests)
- Final report shows: total checks, passed/failed, duration, timestamp
- Start with Settings and Variables sections
- Build custom keywords before test cases
- Use Set Suite Variable to share data between tests
- Generate final report in last test case
- Use Log Many, Log Dictionary for debugging
- This is YOUR ship diagnostic—be creative!
Documentation    Complete ship diagnostic for launch readiness
hints: This is a CAPSTONE challenge - take your time!
Review ALL previous sections if needed
Build incrementally: Settings → Variables → Keywords → Tests
Test each piece before moving to next
Use meaningful variable and keyword names
The challenge is open-ended - show creativity!
Minimum 47 checks, but you can do MORE
solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    Collections
Library    String
Library    DateTime
Documentation    Complete Ship Diagnostic System for Launch Readiness
Suite Setup    Initialize Diagnostic
Suite Teardown    Finalize Diagnostic

*** Variables ***
@{CRITICAL_SYSTEMS}    Navigation    Power Core    Backup Power    Main Engine    Backup Engine
...    Life Support    Oxygen Gen    Water Recycler    Communication    Sensors
&{POWER_THRESHOLDS}    min=75    max=100    critical=90
${LAUNCH_READINESS_REQUIRED}    95
${CHECKS_PASSED}    0
${CHECKS_TOTAL}    0

*** Keywords ***
Initialize Diagnostic
    ${start}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    Set Suite Variable    ${START_TIME}    ${start}
    Log    === SHIP DIAGNOSTIC INITIATED: ${start} ===
    Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_PASSED}    0
    Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}    0

Finalize Diagnostic
    ${end}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    ${duration}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${end}    ${START_TIME}
    Log    === DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE ===
    Log    Duration: ${duration} seconds

Check System Power
    [Arguments]    ${system}    ${power_level}
    ${min}=    Get From Dictionary    ${POWER_THRESHOLDS}    min
    Log    ${system} power: ${power_level}%
    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_TOTAL} + 1
    Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}
    Should Be True    ${power_level} >= ${min}    msg=${system} power too low
    ${CHECKS_PASSED}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_PASSED} + 1
    Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_PASSED}
    [Return]    PASS

Validate System Status
    [Arguments]    ${system}    ${status}
    Log    Validating ${system}: ${status}
    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_TOTAL} + 1
    Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}
    Should Be Equal    ${status}    Online
    ${CHECKS_PASSED}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_PASSED} + 1
    Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_PASSED}

Monitor Until Stable
    [Arguments]    ${system}
    ${attempts}=    Set Variable    0
    WHILE    ${attempts} < 5
        ${attempts}=    Evaluate    ${attempts} + 1
        Log    ${system} stability check ${attempts}/5
        IF    ${attempts} >= 3
            BREAK
        END
    END
    [Return]    Stable

Handle Communication Error
    [Arguments]    ${system}
    TRY
        Log    Testing ${system} communication
        ${test}=    Set Variable    OK
        Should Not Be Empty    ${test}
    EXCEPT    AS    ${error}
        Log    Communication error handled: ${error}
        ${test}=    Set Variable    FALLBACK
    END
    [Return]    ${test}

Generate Report
    ${timestamp}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    ${readiness}=    Evaluate    (${CHECKS_PASSED} / ${CHECKS_TOTAL}) * 100
    Log    === LAUNCH READINESS REPORT ===
    Log    Timestamp: ${timestamp}
    Log    Total Checks: ${CHECKS_TOTAL}
    Log    Passed: ${CHECKS_PASSED}
    Log    Failed: ${CHECKS_TOTAL - CHECKS_PASSED}
    Log    Readiness: ${readiness}%
    Should Be True    ${readiness} >= ${LAUNCH_READINESS_REQUIRED}
    [Return]    ${readiness}

*** Test Cases ***
Power Systems Check
    [Documentation]    Validate all critical system power levels
    FOR    ${system}    IN    @{CRITICAL_SYSTEMS}
        ${power}=    Evaluate    random.randint(80, 98)    modules=random
        Check System Power    ${system}    ${power}
    END

Navigation Validation
    [Documentation]    Comprehensive navigation system checks
    ${nav_status}=    Set Variable    Online
    ${coordinates}=    Create List    X:100    Y:200    Z:300
    Validate System Status    Navigation    ${nav_status}
    ${count}=    Get Length    ${coordinates}
    Should Be Equal As Integers    ${count}    3
    ${first}=    Get From List    ${coordinates}    0
    Should Contain    ${first}    X:

Communication Test
    [Documentation]    Test communication with error handling
    FOR    ${system}    IN    Communication    Sensors
        ${result}=    Handle Communication Error    ${system}
        Should Not Be Empty    ${result}
    END

Life Support Monitoring
    [Documentation]    Monitor life support until stable
    FOR    ${system}    IN    Oxygen Gen    Water Recycler
        ${status}=    Monitor Until Stable    ${system}
        Should Be Equal    ${status}    Stable
    END

Engine Diagnostics
    [Documentation]    Conditional engine validation
    @{engines}=    Create List    Main Engine    Backup Engine
    FOR    ${engine}    IN    @{engines}
        ${temp}=    Evaluate    random.randint(60, 95)    modules=random
        IF    ${temp} < 80
            Log    ${engine}: Normal temp ${temp}°C
        ELSE IF    ${temp} < 90
            Log    ${engine}: Elevated temp ${temp}°C - monitoring
        ELSE
            Log    ${engine}: High temp ${temp}°C - cooldown needed
        END
        ${CHECKS_TOTAL}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_TOTAL} + 1
        ${CHECKS_PASSED}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_PASSED} + 1
        Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}
        Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_PASSED}
    END

System Integration Test
    [Documentation]    Integrated multi-system validation
    &{integration}=    Create Dictionary    nav=Online    power=95    comms=Active
    ${keys}=    Get Dictionary Keys    ${integration}
    FOR    ${key}    IN    @{keys}
        ${value}=    Get From Dictionary    ${integration}    ${key}
        Log    ${key}: ${value}
        ${CHECKS_TOTAL}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_TOTAL} + 1
        ${CHECKS_PASSED}=    Evaluate    ${CHECKS_PASSED} + 1
        Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_TOTAL}
        Set Suite Variable    ${CHECKS_PASSED}
    END

Launch Readiness Report
    [Documentation]    Final diagnostic report
    ${readiness}=    Generate Report
    Log    🚀 LAUNCH APPROVED: Readiness ${readiness}%
    Should Be True    ${CHECKS_TOTAL} >= 47    msg=Insufficient checks: ${CHECKS_TOTAL}/47

theory.title: Final Challenge: Ship Launch Diagnostic System
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "This is what it's all been building toward. Every skill, every concept, every challenge. You're going to build a REAL diagnostic system—the kind that professionals deploy in production. No training wheels. No scaffolding. Just you, Robot Framework, and everything you've learned."

Complete Integration Challenge

This challenge tests EVERYTHING from the fundamentals course:

  • Chapter 1 - First Contact: Syntax, variables (scalar/list/dict), assertions, sequential execution
  • Chapter 2 - System Diagnostics: Settings section, library imports, custom keywords with arguments/returns, documentation
  • Chapter 3 - Logic Circuits: IF/ELSE conditionals, FOR loops, WHILE loops, TRY/EXCEPT error handling
  • Chapter 4 - Component Assembly: Collections (lists/dicts), String manipulation, DateTime operations

You'll build a complete test suite with:

  • Proper organization (4 sections)
  • Reusable keywords
  • Complex control flow
  • Library integration
  • Error handling
  • Reporting and validation

🚀 Integration Requirements

  • Minimum 47 checks across all tests
  • All 4 sections (Settings, Variables, Keywords, Tests)
  • 3 libraries (Collections, String, DateTime)
  • 5+ custom keywords with proper arguments
  • 7+ test cases covering different scenarios
  • Every control flow type: IF, FOR, WHILE, TRY
  • Production patterns: Setup/Teardown, suite variables, reporting
  • All tests must PASS (including validation checks)

What You're Building

A production-grade test automation suite that:

  1. Initializes diagnostic session with timestamp
  2. Validates 10+ critical ship systems
  3. Checks power levels against thresholds
  4. Monitors stability with WHILE loops
  5. Handles errors gracefully with TRY/EXCEPT
  6. Makes decisions with IF/ELSE logic
  7. Iterates through data with FOR loops
  8. Manipulates complex data structures
  9. Generates timestamped final report
  10. Calculates launch readiness percentage

This is the culmination of your training. Take your time. Review previous sections. Build something you're proud of. Show MENTOR-9 what you've learned.

When all tests pass... the ship launches. 🚀
